Aluminum windows in Riyadh

We make aluminum windows to measure for villas and commercial buildings in Riyadh. Choose sliding, casement or fixed windows and glazing suited to the room’s light, ventilation and insulation needs.

Fabrication options

Service options

Sliding windows

Panels move on side tracks where space suits a sliding opening.

Casement windows

Outward-opening sashes provide a wide ventilation opening.

Fixed windows

Fixed glazing brings in daylight and frames the view.

Acoustic windows

Frame and glass combinations help reduce outside noise.

Materials and finish

Specifications and options

What details help price a window installation?

List the number and size of the openings, whether any panels should stay fixed, and whether you need double glazing or insect screens. Check opening clearance around furniture. For iron protection outside a window, see custom window grilles.

  • Double glazing for thermal insulation.
  • Options to reduce heat transfer and cooling demand.
  • Sound insulation of up to 40 dB, depending on the configuration.
  • Sealed frames for resistance to dust and wind.
  • Integrated insect screen options.
  • Frame colors to complement the interior.
From survey to installation

How we work

  1. 01

    Assessment

    We consider exposure, ventilation and insulation needs.

  2. 02

  3. 03

    Each window is prepared to the measured opening.

  4. 04

    Installation and sealing

    We fit the frame, seal the edges and adjust moving sashes.
